scope: Synthetic sparse-observation mechanism audit, not neural training or an independent anatomical benchmark
layout_selection: Two v2 anchors unchanged; spread adds maximum smallest-singular-value points within radius 0.65; cluster chooses three nearest centre vertices. No energy or dense outcome used.
noise_units: Per UV coordinate Gaussian sigma / mean baseline mesh diagonal. Synthetic stress test, not estimated detector error; not 3D physical displacement.
exact_solver: q*=Y pinv(D)^T + q_initial (I-pinv(D)D)^T, nearest unconstrained least-squares optimum. D uses sparse observations only. Geometry feasibility is audited after solution, never assumed or repaired with truth.
dense_evaluation: Exclude union of all four layouts from evaluation for identical evaluation vertices across arms; report all identities, invalid geometry separately.
gate_test: A is residual to noisy sparse observations, not zero truth. g=A/(A+1e-4). Measure gate at truth and exact sparse optimum.
energy_probes: At t=1 with exact anchors, fixed initial lambda=rho*norm(grad A)/norm(grad E/K), rho=0.01,0.1,1. Same bounded coefficient step 0.01 and geometry-checked Armijo for anchor-only and A+lambda E. Single-step scale audit, NOT converged closed-loop gain.
landmarks: Audit all 20 identities x 7 states; test both 0/1-based interpretations of publicly provided 68-point template index list. Fit proper similarity on even entries of the published 36-point correspondence, evaluate odd entries. Coordinate diagnostic only: sample release transforms and BFM.mat kpt_ind equivalence are not assumed. No fitted scale is applied to the baseline meshes.
preserve: Read extracted data only. Do not modify v1/v2 code, results, or dataset. No archive access. No neural-training release.
